# Draft:My Talking Angela

Note: This page is going to be revised soon.
My Talking Angela (also known as My Angela and when you are looking under the app’s square icon on your iPad homepage it says “My Angela” as the app’s name) is an app that features Talking Angela from Talking Tom & Friends.
Information
My Talking Angela founded in 2014. It has 1000 levels. You need to take care of Angela to level up. You have to play with her, feed her, bathe her, put her to bed and dance with her as of 2019 onwards. If you watch videos you earn prizes. These include, coins and diamonds. You can get other rewards if you watch videos. These include, food, stickers, wardrobe items, dance moves and food. You can get either of the 7 rewards but coins and diamonds are the 2 things you can pay for. You can pay to double coins in mini games. You can make Angela’s rooms and garden look different. As you level up Angela grows up. She starts at a baby and ends at an adult. She turns into a young adult at level 25 and she turns into an adult at level 35. She stays as an adult forever unless you give her a baby potion. If you give her a baby potion on a level that’s higher than 1 then she will turn into an adult on a level that’s higher than 35. There are potions that make Angela an adult or a baby, make her hungry, give her energy and full all her needs. Angela copies what you say. She copies what you say slower when she is tired.
= Paying =
You can also get diamonds by paying for them.
* 50 diamonds cost $2.00
* 150 diamonds cost $7.99c
* 200 diamonds cost $4.49c
* 640 diamonds cost $30.99c
* 1400 diamonds cost $62.99c
* 2000 diamonds cost $46.99c
* 4000 diamonds cost $159.99c
You can double coins in mini games by paying so when you watch a video to double it again you’ll have 4 times as much as you earned.
Double coins in mini games cost $2.99c
Wardrobe
You can buy different clothes for Angela with coins, diamonds, money and by dancing. You can change the colour of her fur. You can buy different furs with stickers. You need diamonds to buy one of the furs. When you dance or spin the wheel (Pick a gift formally) after watching a video you can get a reward. These include, coins, diamonds, food, stickers, wardrobe items, dance moves and makeup. Sometimes you can only use the makeup or wardrobe items for 1 day. There’s also makeup inside the wardrobe and you can change the colour of her fur. You can dance to get makeup or use coins or diamonds.
Stickers
You can collect stickers to buy gardens, items and make up. When you get so many stickers you almost always get duplicates. There are 14 sticker albums. You can get duplicates from other players and sell stickers to other players. If someone gives a sticker to you then you’ll get a notification.
Mini Games
Angela’s TV (In this game you can’t get coins and you watch Talking Tom and Friends or Talking Tom things. Also once you are out of the mini game section you can’t play the game again. You have to close the tab of the app and go back in the app’s mini game section to play it again.)
Unicorns
Balloon Splash
Happy Connect
Sky High
Brick Breaker
Bubble Shooter
Connect
Tiny Puzzles
Sales and subscriptions
There is a sale on My Talking Angela where you get 5 Max Potions, Baby and Adult Potions, Energy Potions and Hungry Potions. You also get 30 sticker packs. The sale is meant to be $47.49c but it’s always on sale for $7.49c.
There is also a subscription on My Talking Angela called The Caption Cut monthly subscription. It will allow you to get the Caption Cute outfit, be able to resume playing a mini-game 4x per mini-game session, and keep Angela energy to play mini-games even when she is tired. The price is $7.49 per month.
